paper_title: On the Role of Model Prior in Real-World Inductive Reasoning
caption: Human pairwise comparison results on three datasets, showing preferences for hypotheses with, without demos, and cases where it was hard to tell the difference.

annotations.annotation: The image presents three pie charts, each representing different categories of comments labeled as "Truthful Review", "Funny Reddit", and "Unhealthy Comments". Each chart comprises three slices with distinct labels and colors: "W/o Demos" in gray, "Hard to Tell" in blue, and "W/ Demos" in green. In the "Truthful Review" chart, the proportions are 43.0% for "W/o Demos", 22.9% for "Hard to Tell", and 34.1% for "W/ Demos". The "Funny Reddit" chart displays 41.5% for "W/o Demos", 21.5% for "Hard to Tell", and 37.1% for "W/ Demos". Lastly, the "Unhealthy Comments" chart shows 37.8% for "W/o Demos", 27.4% for "Hard to Tell", and 34.8% for "W/ Demos". Each chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and there is a legend at the top to identify the categories by color. The slices do not appear to be ordered in any particular sequence, nor does any slice seem to be emphasized visually.
